root.label: Initial epidural steroid injection is medically reasonable and necessary
root.source_quote: Epidural steroid injection (ESI) will be considered medically reasonable and necessary when the following three (3) requirements are met

children.label: Qualifying condition supported by history, exam and concordant imaging
children.source_quote: History, physical examination, and concordant radiological image-based diagnostic testing supporting one of the following

children.label: Radiculopathy, radicular pain or neurogenic claudication from disc herniation, osteophyte or severe DDD producing foraminal or central stenosis
children.source_quote: Lumbar, cervical or thoracic radiculopathy, radicular pain and/or neurogenic claudication due to disc herniation, osteophyte or osteophyte complexes, severe degenerative disc disease, producing foraminal or central spinal stenosis

children.label: Imaging concordant with the qualifying condition
Severity documented with a baseline objective scale
Pain greatly impacts quality of life or function
children.source_quote: severe enough to greatly impact quality of life or function

children.label: Objective pain scale or functional assessment recorded at baseline
children.source_quote: An objective pain scale or functional assessment must be performed at baseline (prior to interventions)

children.label: Duration and conservative care requirement
children.source_quote: Pain duration of at least four (4) weeks, and the inability to tolerate noninvasive conservative care or medical documentation of failure to respond to four (4) weeks of noninvasive conservative care or acute herpes zoster refractory to conservative management where a four (4) week wait is not required

children.label: Four weeks of pain and failed or intolerable conservative care
Pain duration of at least 4 weeks
children.source_quote: Pain duration of at least four (4) weeks

children.label: Failure of 4 weeks of noninvasive conservative care, or inability to tolerate it
children.source_quote: the inability to tolerate noninvasive conservative care or medical documentation of failure to respond to four (4) weeks of noninvasive conservative care

children.label: Acute herpes zoster refractory to conservative management (4-week wait not required)
children.source_quote: acute herpes zoster refractory to conservative management

children.label: Enrolled in active rehabilitation, home exercise or functional restoration program
children.source_quote: should be part of an active rehabilitation program, home exercise program or functional restoration program

children.label: No contraindication (spinal or systemic infection, cord/conus/cauda equina compression, cancer risk)
children.source_quote: suspected or active localized spinal infection, significant systemic infection, compressive lesions of the spinal cord, conus medullaris or cauda equina, suspicion or major risk factors for cancer

children.label: No more than 4 ESI sessions in this spinal region in the past 12 months
children.source_quote: ESIs are limited to a maximum of four (4) sessions per spinal region in a rolling twelve (12) month period

excluded.quote: The ESIs must be performed under CT or fluoroscopy image guidance with contrast
excluded.reason: Procedure technique, specified on the order; not chart evidence.

excluded.quote: Transforaminal epidural steroid injections (TFESIs) involving a maximum of two (2) levels in one spinal region
Caudal epidural steroid injections (CESIs) and interlaminar epidural steroid injections (ILESIs) involving a maximum of one level
It is medically reasonable and necessary to perform TFESIs bilaterally only when clinically indicated.
Repeat ESI when the first injection directly and significantly provided improvement
excluded.reason: Applies to repeat injections; the v1 benchmark covers initial requests.

excluded.quote: An initial injection of contrast is required to confirm epidural placement
The ESIs should be performed in conjunction with conservative treatments.
excluded.reason: Covered by the rehab and dur.conservative leaves.

excluded.quote: ESIs to treat non-specific low back pain (LBP), axial spine pain
excluded.reason: Exclusion enforced by the dx.condition leaves requiring a specific qualifying condition.

excluded.quote: Use of Moderate or Deep Sedation, General Anesthesia, and Monitored Anesthesia Care (MAC)
It generally would not be considered medically reasonable and necessary for treatment with ESI to extend beyond 12 months.
excluded.reason: Applies to continuation beyond 12 months; v1 covers initial requests.
